_comment: Workbook exercise plant-heat-pump, the threshold lesson: heatpump_defrost with max_reversals_per_day at 20 instead of the generic 24 (warn at 20, fault at 40), as a ceiling set just above the healthy sister unit's 13.57 a day might be. ASHP__defrost_timer (a 60-minute time-temperature defrost, 23.43 a day) then warns. The limit belongs to the unit's defrost control, not to CAMBER: take it from the unit's documentation or a known-good cold spell.
